title: Tony G NDE 4811
content: I was taken to the hospital after accidental mixing of alcohol with tablets. In the ambulance, I refused to lie down. I was sitting next to the paramedic as we were travelling. I remember feeling faint and trying to reach his arm. I was taken to the hospital and whilst lying on the trolley, the person with me heard a mayday alert. I saw the medical team rush to me. They hurried me off to the resuscitation room. I believe it was at that time I was moving in a dark tunnel. I do not remember leaving my body but just seemed to be floating. I remember hearing a quiet rushing sound, as I progressed in the tunnel. I saw my paternal grandmother holding a little boy's hand that was standing next to her. I believe the little boy was my son who was born and lived only for two days but showed himself to me as about three years old (the age he would have been had he lived). They were standing still and I just saw a sideway profile of them. They did not acknowledge me, although I was trying to call my grandmother, they just ignored me and did not move. I did not have a body and can only explain I could see and hear but feel I was just an eye moving along. I did not see any light but there was what looked like a wall further on from my grandmother and son. I do not recall going back to my body. I woke up two days later, and told people of seeing my grandmother and son straight away, even after more than thirty years the memory of this experience never fades.
